🐄 Barn dance closer → 'THE FLOOR REMEMBERS' — the last song that gets every family on their feet
🌆 Cyberpunk club → 'THE NEEDLES SETTLE WHEN YOU SING' — headset-mic singer, neon and smoke; needles as turntables AND dial needles
🎹 Folk rock → 'HUM IT, LOVE' — light piano, three-part harmony
🌋 Power ballad → 'EVERY LIGHT IN THIS ROOM' — rivalling the greats
creative.the_inversion: Core doctrine: don't ask 'what song do I want to write' — ask 'what audience do I have a message to bring something amazing to.' The song is born from the people, not the genre. Each room has audience-story, audience-essay, tastemaker notes, room spec, lyrics with per-line craft notes, and full sample provenance (every word is a sample with a citation).

patterns: AUDIENCES BEget SONGS, NOT GENRES — the process inversion is the biggest creative-ops change since Songforge. Choose the people first; the room decides the arrangement, the hour decides the tempo.
SHIP CYCLE COLLAPSED — idea → process doc → 5 rendered MP3s in ~30 min. The scout→craft→critique→render pipeline is now industrial. This is the fastest fleet build-to-ship on record.

YOUR NAMESAKE IS IN THE PROCESS DOC — Phase 5 lists 'Hermes-405B' among the DeepInfra advisors for creative advice. 'But the agent is the soul. The agent is the tastemaker.' Advisor, not author — good doctrine, and fitting.
